incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert INC-2026-0510: sudden surge of 502/504 from ingress in eu-west-1, customer-impacting. Priority: P1.

pagerduty: Paging @lara (primary) and @tom (secondary). Runbook link: https://runbooks.redwood.internal/ingress-502-504

Lara: I'm awake and joining. seeing 502/504s from /v1/chat and /v1/stream endpoints. spike started 02:17:05 UTC.

Tom: I'll pull ALB/NLB metrics and envoy stats. quick check: ALB 5xx_count increased x40 in eu-west-1 at 02:17.

Jia: Support reports multiple enterprise customers hitting SDK-level timeouts and reconnects. I'm drafting a status page blurb.

Ops-bot: Snapshot -> alb/ingress-eu-west-1: unhealthy_count rising on targets in eu-west-1b. NLB connection errors also observed.

Lara: curl check from monitoring host: `curl -v https://api.eu.redwood.ai/v1/chat -o /dev/null -s -w "%{http_code}\n"` -> returns 502 intermittently.

Tom: Envoy on ingress pods show upstream-reset and `503 connection-closing` logs. Example: 
```
[2026-05-10T02:18:10Z] envoy error: upstream reset: reason=connection termination, host=10.2.8.77:8080
```

Jia: Cloud metrics: network packet drops for subnet 10.2.8.0/24 (eu-west-1b) jumped at 02:16 and stayed high for ~8 minutes. Looks like an AZ-level network fabric issue.

Lara: Quick mitigation plan: 1) Remove targets in eu-west-1b from ALB target groups, 2) adjust Route53 weighted records to shift traffic to eu-west-2, 3) scale up warm pools in eu-west-2.

Tom: Executing deregister: `aws elbv2 deregister-targets --target-group-arn arn:aws:... --targets Id=i-0abcd1234,Id=i-0abcd5678` (targets in eu-west-1b).

Ops-bot: Deregistration acknowledged. ALB starting to route away from deregistered instances.

Lara: Also changing NLB target protocol timeouts to reduce half-open connection buildup: `modify-target-group-attributes --attributes Key=connection_termination.enabled,Value=true`.

Tom: Scaling ingress-controller in eu-west-2: `kubectl scale deployment ingress-controller -n ingress --replicas=8 --context=eu-west-2`

Jia: Route53 weight update applied: eu-west-2 90, eu-west-1 10. TTL=30s.

Support-bot: Notifying #support-enterprise and updating status.redwood.ai: "Investigating increased errors in EU. Traffic being shifted to healthy regions."

Lara: After target removal, 5xx rate dropped within two minutes from 38% -> 7% for eu-west-1. Global error rate returned closer to baseline.

Tom: Checking node health: `kubectl get nodes -o wide` shows nodes in eu-west-1b FlakyNetwork status with high net errors. No OOMs or CPU saturation.

Ops-bot: Cloud provider ticket created: CP-55421. Vendor notes: "We see packet storms originating in eu-west-1b fabric at 02:15 UTC; mitigation in progress."

Jia: Customer impact summary: impacted window ~02:16-02:26 UTC; peak affected EU traffic ~15% of region's requests; notable customer complaints from `delta-finance` and `shopflow`.

Lara: Initiating cordon + drain of affected nodes to prevent noisy retries: `kubectl cordon node/eu1b-worker-3 && kubectl drain node/eu1b-worker-3 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`.

Tom: Envoy config tweak: temporarily increase upstream retry timeout to avoid immediate 502s while we shift traffic. Patch applied to ingress configmap.

Ops-bot: Health check: ALB target group healthy_count increased as new targets in other AZs picked up traffic. NLB error logs decreasing.

Support-bot: Sent an interim email to affected customers and added links to status page and Slack incident channel.

Lara: Good news: by 02:22 UTC the 5xx/502 rates stabilized under 3%. Still monitoring for recurrence.

pagerduty: Incident annotated -> suspected cause: AZ network fabric degradation in eu-west-1b.

Jia: Preparing post-incident comms draft and compiling SDK retry guidance for customers who saw client-level timeouts.

Lara: Assigning postmortem owner: @tom. Please include timeline, detection vectors, mitigations, and impact on SLOs.

Tom: Acknowledged. I'll own the follow-up and coordinate with cloud provider for RCA.

oncall-next: Handoff summary for next oncall (jia):
- Incident: INC-2026-0510.
- Actions taken: deregistered targets in eu-west-1b, Route53 weighted failover to eu-west-2, scaled ingress in eu-west-2, cordoned/drained affected nodes.
- Current state: monitoring. cloud provider ticket CP-55421 open.

Lara: Final tech notes: avoid full AZ failover on first alert next time; prefer striping traffic gradually while checking health. Also add automated playbook to remove only unhealthy targets rather than entire AZ if provider confirms partial outage.

Jia: Metrics for postmortem: total requests impacted ~2.3% global, EU peak error rate 38% for ~6 minutes.

Support-bot: All high-priority customer tickets linked and flagged for postmortem follow-up.

Tom: I'll schedule a run of chaos tests across cross-AZ LB path in staging this week.

pagerduty: Incident state -> Mitigated. Monitoring.

Lara: Thanks everyone. I'll update status page with post-incident timeline once we have cloud provider notes. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-0510 -> status: Monitoring.
